# W2 handoff: Repo core

Workstream W2 of [`15-build-plan.md`](../../spec/15-build-plan.md), on branch `ws/w2-repo-core`. Owns `internal/gitstore`, `internal/repo` (with `repotest`), `internal/api/repos.go`, `internal/api/uploads.go`, and, by [decisions.md](../decisions.md), `internal/api/search.go` and `internal/api/namespaces.go`. Changes needed elsewhere are in [`requests/w2.md`](../requests/w2.md).

## Done, by feature ID

| ID | What | Where |
|---|---|---|
| REPO-1 | Model and dataset Repos under user and Organisation Namespaces; IDs keep their case, lookups ignore it; a model and a dataset may share a name. | `repo.Store.Create`, `Get`; `POST /repos`, `GET /repos/{type}/{ns}/{name}` |
| REPO-2 | Visibility stored and enforced in listings (public with `anonymous_read`, internal for signed-in users, private for Namespace members, collaborators and admins; Token restrictions narrow it). Handlers check `auth.Authz` and answer 404 (401 when anonymous) so private names do not leak. | `repo.Store.List`, `api.RepoDeps.load` |
| REPO-3 | Branches, tags (lightweight and annotated, peeled in listings), Commit log with path filter, Commit detail with a file-level diff summary, text diffs for files under 1 MiB, size and SHA changes for LFS and binary files. | `Refs`, `CreateBranch`, `DeleteBranch`, `CreateTag`, `DeleteTag`, `Log`, `GetCommit`, `Diff`, `FileDiff`; `/refs`, `/commits`, `/commits/{sha}`, `/commits/{sha}/diff` |
| REPO-4 | Rename and transfer with redirects from every old ID; a new Repo at an old ID replaces the redirect; case-only renames keep working. `Get` returns the canonical ID so handlers can redirect. | `Rename`, `Transfer`; `/rename`, `/transfer` |
| REPO-5 | Soft delete, restore within `repos.restore_window`, `repo.purge` Job that deletes git data and rows when the window ends (a restored or re-deleted Repo is not purged by a stale Job). LFS objects are left for GC with `last_referenced_at` set. | `Delete`, `Restore`, `Purge`, `runPurge`; `DELETE`, `/restore` |
| REPO-9 | Description, default branch (moves `head_ref`), tags, licence, gating, visibility. Audit and webhook events for visibility changes. | `UpdateSettings`; `PATCH /repos/{type}/{ns}/{name}` |
| UP-6 | LFS objects are stored once per Instance: `Ingest` returns a stored object without reading the body, upload plans answer `exists`, Commits and pushes reference stored objects. | `repo.LFS` |
| Commit and ref CAS | Server-side Commits: new objects written in a staging repository, packed alone, uploaded, then one transaction that compare-and-swaps every ref, marks the pack live and records `repo_lfs`. Pushes and Mirror syncs (`ApplyPack`) use the same path with the 04-git.md policy (ref namespaces, default branch protection, force-push rule, `git.max_blob_size`, `git.max_pack_size`, LFS pointers must name verified objects, quota hook). An object written through a presigned URL and not yet verified is verified on the spot, and the write waits at most `lfs.verify_wait` for it before failing with a message that names the object; the verification carries on, so a retry finds it done. Conflicts orphan the pack and change nothing. Commits with `parent_commit` lose with `ErrParentMismatch` (412); without it they retry up to 3 times when no path they touch changed. | `gitstore.UpdateRefs`, `repo.Store.Commit`, `ApplyPack`, `UpdateRefs` |
| git storage | Immutable packs in the Blob store (`git/<uuid>/pack/pack-<sha>.{pack,rev,bitmap,idx}`), refs and the pack list in the database, an LRU-bounded local pack cache with singleflight downloads, per-request views with `packed-refs` from one snapshot, `git.compact` with reachability bitmaps, a sweep of retired, orphaned and abandoned packs, `hangar.git.cache.*` and `hangar.git.pack.duration` metrics. | `internal/gitstore` |
| Tree and Commit caches | `tree_entries` holds every path of a Commit, with a root row written last as the "complete" marker, LFS pointer details and last Commits (inherited from the first parent, or computed with one `git log` walk on first use and saved). `commits` is filled on every ref move. Both rebuild from git when rows are missing, including on a replica with a cold pack cache. | `internal/repo/cache.go` |
| Zip export Job | `zip.export` streams a Revision (or one folder) into `exports/<job>.zip`; the result has a presigned URL or a signed Hangar URL served by `api.ExportHandler`. | `repo.Store.RegisterJobs`, `POST .../zip`, `api.ExportURL` |
| LFS store | `repo.LFSStore` for every other workstream: verified-only records, streaming multipart ingest straight to the final key for large objects, multipart uploads staged under `tmp/`, presigned PUT and part URLs, `Verify` re-hashing, `upload.expire` Job. | `repo.LFS` |
| Native API | `/repos` (list with filters, facets and sorts; create; get; update; delete; restore; rename; transfer; refs; Commits; Commit detail and diff; tree root and tree with presence, scan status and last Commit; zip), uploads (`plan`, `GET` upload, `PUT` part, `complete`, `POST .../commits` including `create_pr`), `/search` and `/namespaces/{ns}`. | `internal/api/{repos,uploads,search,namespaces}.go` |

## What is tested, and how to run it

Every Repo service test runs on SQLite and Postgres (`dbtest.ForEachDriver`; `make test` turns Postgres on with testcontainers).

```sh
export PATH=~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.19.0/bin:$PATH
make lint test
HANGAR_TEST_POSTGRES=1 go test -race -count=1 -tags integration ./internal/repo/... ./internal/gitstore/... ./internal/api/...
```

Definition of done, test by test:

- **Byte-identical Commits:** `TestCommitsAreByteIdenticalToGit` makes the same Commits (adds, adds that `.gitattributes` puts in LFS, LFS adds, copies, deletes, folder deletes, empty files) through `repo.Store` and through the `repotest` fake, which drives git plumbing, and compares SHAs; it then clones a view to an exported copy and runs `git fsck --strict --no-dangling`, `git cat-file -p` and `git ls-tree -r` against the fake's repository. Finally it rebuilds every Commit of the exported copy with `git add` and `git commit` in a fresh repository (same files, author, committer and message) and checks that git gives the same SHA, which checks tree and Commit encoding against git porcelain rather than against the plumbing both implementations use.
- **Ref CAS under concurrency:** `TestRefCASUnderConcurrency` (6 concurrent `UpdateRefs` from one old value: exactly one wins; 5 concurrent Commits with the same `parent_commit`: one wins, the rest get `ErrParentMismatch`; concurrent Commits without one retry or lose cleanly and every winner's file is on the branch), `TestApplyPackMirrorAndConcurrentPushes` (two racing pushes: one wins), `gitstore.TestUpdateRefsCompareAndSwap` (create, update and delete CAS, all or nothing).
- **Rename redirects:** `TestRenameAndTransferRedirect`, and the API's `TestRepoLifecycleEndpoints`.
- **Soft delete and purge:** `TestDeleteRestoreAndPurge`, `TestPurgeJobWaitsForTheRestoreWindow`.
- **Partial mirror presence flags:** `TestPartialMirrorPresence`, `TestApplyPackMirrorAndConcurrentPushes`, `TestCachesRebuildFromGit`.

Also: push policy (`TestApplyPackPushPolicy`, `TestApplyPackBlobAndLFSPolicy`), `lfs.verify_wait` for Commits and pushes (`TestWritesWaitForLFSVerification`), the fake's LFS handling and Namespace mapping (`TestAddsFollowGitAttributes`, `TestMapNamespace`), LFS store (`TestLFS*`, `TestIngestStreamsLargeObjects`), listing (`TestList*`), Jobs (`TestZipExportJob`, `TestCompactionJob`, `TestUploadExpireJobAndSchedules`), gitstore (`TestViewServesSnapshotOfRefs`, `TestCacheEvictsLeastRecentlyUsed`, `TestSweepAndDeleteRepo`, `TestIndexPackAndCompact`), and the native API end to end through the generated router over real HTTP with encoded `rev` and `path` (`internal/api/repos_test.go`).

Coverage with Postgres on: `internal/repo` 85.7 % (floor 85 %), `internal/repo/repotest` 85.0 %, `internal/gitstore` 83.0 %, `internal/api` 82.7 %.

W2 owns no compat suite. `repotest.NewReal(t, d)` builds the real service on a test database for W3, W4 and W6 (with `AddUser` and `AddOrg`, because Repos need their Namespace row).

### Checked against the other branches

All on 2026-10-13, in throwaway worktrees that merged `ws/w2-repo-core` (at `555d9b7`, the code as handed off) with the other branch cleanly; nothing from them is committed here.

- **W1's real Blob stores** (`ws/w1-platform` at `8fb372f`): with `internal/repo`, `internal/gitstore` and `repotest.NewReal` switched to `fs.New(t.TempDir())`, `HANGAR_TEST_POSTGRES=1 go test -race -tags integration ./internal/gitstore/ ./internal/repo/... ./internal/api/` passes on SQLite and Postgres except `TestPresignedStoreAndQuota`, which asserts the fake's presigned URL format and fails with `blob: not supported by this backend`, as it should on the filesystem. Against MinIO (`blobtest.S3`, `HANGAR_TEST_MINIO=1`) `internal/gitstore` passes and `internal/repo` fails only the three assertions that expect the fake's "not supported" or its URL host.
- **W3** (`ws/w3-git-server` at `ec31582`, with the `compat/git/backend_real_test.go` from W3's handoff): `HANGAR_TEST_POSTGRES=1 go test -tags compat -v ./compat/git/` passes, 22 subtests on each of the `fake`, `real-sqlite` and `real-postgres` backends (`ok github.com/jamesagarside/hangar/compat/git 283.563s`); `internal/gitserver`, `internal/upstream` and `internal/scan` pass too.
- **W4** (`ws/w4-hub-api` at `73889d0`, with the `compat/hf/backend_real_test.go` from W4's handoff): `go test ./internal/hfapi/...` passes, and `uv run --project compat pytest compat/hf` gives `36 passed` on the fakes, on the real service on SQLite (`HANGAR_HF_GO_TAGS=w2real`) and on Postgres (`HANGAR_HF_DB=postgres`); the matrix file records the backend as `internal/repo (W2) on sqlite` and `on postgres`.

## Known gaps

- Server-side Commits use git plumbing rather than go-git (request 1).
- Compaction keeps unreachable objects (`--keep-unreachable`), so nothing is ever pruned from packs; this avoids deleting an object a concurrent ref update points at, at the cost of space.
- A replica's pack cache keeps retired packs for a cached Repo until the Repo is evicted.
- `List` with metadata filters, facets or the parameters, downloads and likes sorts loads every visible candidate and calls the indexer per Repo. Plain listings are paged in SQL. This will not meet the 100,000-Repo target for filtered listings; it needs a metadata query from W7.
- The tree cache is filled synchronously after each branch move, so a push of a very large tree waits for it. Readers rebuild it on demand.
- `Log` runs `git log` on every call; only `GetCommit` and last-Commit titles use the `commits` cache.
- Native API `Repo` responses leave out `mirror_status` (W6's table), `liked` (no per-user query in `community.Service`) and Namespace `avatar_url`.
- Tests on this branch use `blobtest.Fake`, because W1's stores are not on it; the runs against W1's filesystem and MinIO stores above were made in a throwaway merge.
- Commit messages are stored exactly as given, without the trailing newline `git commit` adds (as `git commit-tree -F` and go-git write them). The fake does the same, so SHAs agree everywhere in Hangar.
- Upload parts through Hangar hit the native API body limit until request 6 is done.

## What the integration lead must wire

```go
gs, err := gitstore.New(gitstore.Options{DB: d, Blobs: blobs, CacheDir: cfg.Git.CacheDir, CacheSize: cfg.Git.CacheSize.Int64(),
	Timeout: cfg.Git.Timeout, Instruments: tel.Instruments, Log: log})
lfs := repo.NewLFS(d, blobs)
repos, err := repo.NewStore(repo.Options{DB: d, Git: gs, LFS: lfs, Namespaces: orgService, Jobs: queue, Webhooks: emitter,
	Audit: recorder, Quota: quotaChecker, Index: indexer, Community: community, AnonymousRead: cfg.Security.AnonymousRead,
	RestoreWindow: cfg.Repos.RestoreWindow, MaxBlobSize: cfg.Git.MaxBlobSize.Int64(), MaxPackSize: cfg.Git.MaxPackSize.Int64(),
	AllowForcePush: cfg.Git.AllowForcePush, CompactThreshold: cfg.Git.CompactThreshold, VerifyWait: cfg.LFS.VerifyWait, Log: log})
err = repos.RegisterJobs(registry, lfs, repo.JobOptions{Blobs: blobs, ExportURL: api.ExportURL(cfg.Server.PublicURL, blobs, signer),
	PackGracePeriod: cfg.Git.PackGracePeriod})
for _, s := range repo.Schedules() { _ = queue.SetSchedule(ctx, s) } // upload.expire hourly
deps := api.RepoDeps{Repos: repos, LFS: lfs, Authz: authz, Orgs: orgService, Jobs: queue, Collections: collections,
	NamespaceSearch: orgService, Community: community, Index: indexer, Scanner: scanner, PublicURL: cfg.Server.PublicURL,
	UploadURLTTL: cfg.LFS.UploadURLTTL, InlineMax: cfg.HFAPI.RegularUploadMax.Int64(), Facets: true, Log: log}
```

- Compose the native server from `*api.ReposAPI`, `*api.UploadsAPI`, `*api.SearchAPI` and `*api.NamespacesAPI` (constructors `api.NewReposAPI(deps)` and so on) with the other workstreams' handler types embedded at depth 1 and `gen.Unimplemented` one level deeper, as `internal/api/repos_test.go` does.
- Mount `api.ExportHandler(blobs, signer)` at `api.ExportPath` outside the generated router and auth (request 5), and exempt upload parts from the body limit (request 6).
- `repo.Store` is the `repo.Service` and `repo.LFS` the `repo.LFSStore` for every other workstream (W3, W4, W6, W7, W10, W11).
- W7's `index` and `scan` handlers decode `repo.CommitJob` (request 7). `git.compact`, `repo.purge`, `zip.export` and `upload.expire` are registered by `RegisterJobs`; register each kind only once.
- The image needs `git` 2.39 or later (04-git.md); `gitstore` runs it for every object operation.
- Test helpers in package `api_test`: W2's are named `reposServer` and `reposUnimplemented` so they do not clash with W1's `unimplemented` and W5's `server`. W1 and W5 both declare `env` and `newEnv` there, which clash with each other (request 8).
- `repotest.Fake` now stores `OpAdd` files that `.gitattributes` tracks as LFS objects, and `MapNamespace(name, id)` gives Repos their Organisation's Namespace ID, which removes the two workarounds in `requests/w4.md` item 7.

## Bellatrix preview fixes (fix/pf1-upload, 2026-10-17)

- **Presigned single PUTs sign no headers** (finding 1). `LFS.PresignPut` writes to `tmp/uploads/<id>` with an `uploads` row of kind `lfs-put`; `LFS.Verify` hashes staged objects newest first, copies a match to the object's key and discards the rest, then falls back to the object's own key for URLs issued before the change. `abort` and `upload.expire` delete a staged object. Tests: `TestPresignedPutWorksWithoutHeaders`, `TestPresignedPutCannotReplaceAVerifiedObject`, `TestPresignedPutVerifyRejectsWrongContent`; compat: `compat/hf` `TestHubBasicUploadToMinIOWithoutXet`.
- **Completion copies instead of re-uploading** (finding 13b). `CompleteUpload` hashes the assembled object once (`resumingReader`, finding 13a, already fixed in `2284992`) and copies it into place with `blob.Store.Copy` (`promote`). No bytes are written through Hangar. Tests: `TestCompleteUploadCopiesServerSide`, `TestCompleteUploadKeepsPartsWhenTheCopyFails`.
- **Completion outlives its caller** (finding 13c). `CompleteUpload` runs without the request's cancellation, bounded by an hour plus a second per 10 MiB, and a completion sent while one runs joins it (singleflight per upload, per process). A finished completion removes the upload, so a resent one gets 404 and the client plans the file again, which answers `exists`. Keeping the parts after a failed completion was already done in `2284992`. A Job with polling was considered and not done: it needs an API change for every client (the hf multipart completion is synchronous), and carrying on plus a client retry covers the cut-off case. Tests: `TestCompleteUploadCarriesOnWhenTheCallerGoesAway`, `TestCompleteUploadFinishesAfterTheCallerLeft`.
- **Creating an existing Repo** inserts with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` (finding 6), so `create_repo(exist_ok=True)` no longer logs a duplicate key ERROR in Postgres. Test: `TestCreateExistingRepoCausesNoDatabaseError`.
